title: Low Take-up Rate for Climate-Friendly Households Programme
what_it_is: Low Take-up Rate for Climate-Friendly Households Programme

sections.label: Climate-Friendly Households Programme vouchers
sections.summary: The Climate-Friendly Households Programme encourages 1-, 2- and 3-room HDB households to switch to resource-efficient appliances, with outreach and monitoring of voucher take-up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The Climate-Friendly Households Programme aims to encourage 1-, 2- and 3-room HDB households to make the switch to resource-efficient and climate-friendly appliances – refrigerators, LED lighting and shower fittings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: From NEA’s earlier market survey on refrigerators, a $150 voucher amount was sufficient to defray the average incremental cost of energy efficient models.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: To improve the programme take-up rate, NEA and PUB have been working with community partners to conduct outreach activities to residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Posters on the Programme have also been displayed at Community Clubs and digital display panels at some HDB blocks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor the take-up rate of the vouchers and review the Programme at an appropriate juncture.

sections.label: Programme review and extension
sections.summary: The current phase ends 31 December 2023, and NEA and PUB are reviewing whether to extend the programme to cover more appliances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The current programme is designed to help low-income HDB households to make the switch to more energy-efficient appliances while saving costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: This current phase of programme will end on 31 December 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: NEA and PUB are currently conducting a review of the programme and will look at whether we could extend the programme to cover more appliances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Ultimately, we are looking at electrical appliances, so whether the likes of bicycles can be covered, yes, it is an energy zero device for mobility, but we will look at it and announce further details when ready.
